S2P Platform Setup for New Orgs

The following is presented as a n unofficial checklist of the most important tasks in setting up a brand new S2P org. We have attempted to present the tasks in a logical order, but this document is not meant to be all - inclusive, to cover strategies/best practices, or to dictate the order in which t asks must be accomplished . All of these will vary based on numerous client or implementation -specific factors (for example, the availability of information from the client team). This document can serve as a place to double -check whether you’ve neglected to set up an important site element.
Licenses o Verify that all ap propriate licenses are enabled
• Site Display Name (for login page, and to fill placeholder for org name in notification emails)
• Syndicate to data warehouse (enable if data is needed for reports in a non -production org)
• Supplier Profile Access Permissions (applies to TSM, but enable it now if the client has TSM) o Org Classification
• Other options as approp riate o Shipping Method

sections.title: Integrations
paragraphs: Last updated 1/16/2018 . JAGGAER Confidential. Copyright © 201 7, JAGGAER Page 2 | 5
o Understand which integrations are part of the implementation, how they are progressing, and how they will impact functional tasks of the Solutions Consultant. Common integrations include:

Org Images, Messaging & Behavior o Obtain and import client graphics of all necessary sizes o Import any additional graphics needed for suppliers or supplier classes o Assign primary org logos ( Setup > Site Appearance > Org Message & Site Logos ) o On the same page, set up org message and site contact info o Set up Terms and Conditions o Create a color them e based on the client's color preferences o Set that theme as the site default (under Setup > General Site Settings > System Settings & Config )

• On this page, also set up help options and default org home page o Modify (if necessary) Document Search Settings fo r all site documents (potentially including Requisitions, POs, Receipts, Invoices, Sourcing Events, Contracts, Form Requests, Savings Initiatives) o Modify (if necessary) Configure Approval Search Settings for all documents
Org Struc ture & Settings o Busine ss Units o Default Addresses* o Departments o User Roles

• Certain permissions will not appear until specific functionality is turned on for the org. Take a detour and enable the following IF the client is using these features: o Email Approvals - Setup > Workflow Setup > General Workflow Settings . o Trade -Ins o Shared Cart – Setup > Configure Documents > General Document Config Settings

• Configure top -level org role with all permissions and settings that will apply to any user throughout the life of the client's system ; CAUTION: Keep in mind that as products are added in the future, the settings in the top -level role will apply to EVERYONE, so for example if setting up TCM only, don't give this role permission to Manage Contracts or all users will be able to do it.
• Configure inactive 'umbrella' roles for all the functions available in the client's org

For each, the following steps will be part of the process:
1. Work with client to determine what information will appear and how it will be arranged on each document
2. Set up any Custom Fields that need to be added to existing system fields
3. Import XML or use templates for initial document
5. If using Contract Compliance Tracker, set contra ct settings for each document (whether to check and enforce budget and other contract requirements)
